Tekno is a 3 level duel map, with plenty of tricky jumps and shortcuts that connects key items. The map is intended for technical and fast paced gameplay, the layout has many jumps over gaps that offers a risk for getting caught in the air by the lightning gun. Items are standard except for the 2 mega healths.

Location file is made by {{player|flintheart|flag=se}}
